description: Lite Vanilla Extras is a small, modular vanilla-plus mod created for experimentation and fun. It introduces simple features like new creatures and resources while keeping changes minimal and balanced. Each addition is designed to be lightweight, optional, and true to the original Minecraft feel.

mods.name: Lite Vanilla Extras
mods.description: Lite Vanilla Extras is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly mod that adds small, natural features to Minecraft.
